import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import lightgbm as lgb
import re

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data from correct paths
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features
punctuation = "!\"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~"


def extract_text_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        length = len(text)
        words = text.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        char_count = len(text.replace(" ", ""))
        punct_count = sum(1 for c in text if c in punctuation)
        question_count = text.count("?")
        exclamation_count = text.count("!")
        period_count = text.count(".")
        avg_word_len = char_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        uppercase_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
        uppercase_ratio = uppercase_count / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0
        features.append(
            [
                length,
                word_count,
                char_count,
                punct_count,
                question_count,
                exclamation_count,
                period_count,
                avg_word_len,
                uppercase_ratio,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


X_train_full = train_df["text"].values
y_train_full = train_df["author"].values
X_test = test_df["text"].values

# Split for validation (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# TF-IDF with reduced dimensions
tfidf_bigram = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=10000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)

tfidf_unigram = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 1), max_features=10000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)

# Fit vectorizers on training data only
tfidf_bigram.fit(X_train)
tfidf_unigram.fit(X_train)

# Transform training and validation sets
X_train_bigram = tfidf_bigram.transform(X_train)
X_train_unigram = tfidf_unigram.transform(X_train)
X_train_text = extract_text_features(X_train)

X_val_bigram = tfidf_bigram.transform(X_val)
X_val_unigram = tfidf_unigram.transform(X_val)
X_val_text = extract_text_features(X_val)

X_test_bigram = tfidf_bigram.transform(X_test)
X_test_unigram = tfidf_unigram.transform(X_test)
X_test_text = extract_text_features(X_test)

# Combine features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_bigram, X_train_unigram, csr_matrix(X_train_text)])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_bigram, X_val_unigram, csr_matrix(X_val_text)])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_bigram, X_test_unigram, csr_matrix(X_test_text)])

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_train)
y_val_encoded = le.transform(y_val)

# Create LightGBM dataset for validation
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train_combined, y_train_encoded)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val_combined, y_val_encoded, reference=lgb_train)

# Train LightGBM with early stopping
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 3,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": 7,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "feature_fraction_seed": 42,
    "drop_seed": 42,
    "data_random_seed": 42,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Predict on validation set
val_probs = model.predict(X_val_combined)
val_loss = log_loss(y_val_encoded, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_loss:.6f}")

# Retrain on full training data with optimized parameters
tfidf_bigram.fit(X_train_full)
tfidf_unigram.fit(X_train_full)

X_train_full_bigram = tfidf_bigram.transform(X_train_full)
X_train_full_unigram = tfidf_unigram.transform(X_train_full)
X_train_full_text = extract_text_features(X_train_full)

X_train_full_combined = hstack(
    [X_train_full_bigram, X_train_full_unigram, csr_matrix(X_train_full_text)]
)
y_train_full_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_train_full)

# Retrain model on full data
lgb_train_full = lgb.Dataset(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full_encoded)
model_full = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train_full,
    num_boost_round=300,  # Fixed number based on early stopping from validation
    callbacks=[lgb.verbosity(0)],
)

# Predict on test set
X_test_full_bigram = tfidf_bigram.transform(X_test)
X_test_full_unigram = tfidf_unigram.transform(X_test)
X_test_full_text = extract_text_features(X_test)
X_test_full_combined = hstack(
    [X_test_full_bigram, X_test_full_unigram, csr_matrix(X_test_full_text)]
)

test_probs = model_full.predict(X_test_full_combined)

# Create submission file
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
submission_df["EAP"] = test_probs[:, 0]
submission_df["HPL"] = test_probs[:, 1]
submission_df["MWS"] = test_probs[:, 2]

# Ensure output directory exists and save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully!")
